question: Should ClawSegmentedControl globally wrap every option set larger than four, or should the multi-row layout be localized to Skill Workshop?
rationale: Both implementations can fix the demonstrated truncation, but only Android ownership can decide whether vertical growth is the permanent shared-component contract for unrelated callers.

options.title: Approve shared wrapping
options.body: Adopt balanced wrapping as the component-wide behavior after confirming existing callers tolerate the added height.

options.title: Localize Skill Workshop
options.body: Preserve the shared single-row contract and apply an adaptive or caller-specific layout only to the five-filter Skill Workshop surface.

recommendation.title: Approve shared wrapping
recommendation.body: Adopt balanced wrapping as the component-wide behavior after confirming existing callers tolerate the added height.
